calculation.expression: momentum_20d = close/close.shift(20)-1; breadth = mean(momentum_20d > 0 across 15 assets).shift(1); signal = momentum_20d.shift(1) if breadth >= 0.40 else -momentum_20d.shift(1)
calculation.description: Uses lagged cross-asset breadth to select trend-following momentum when at least 40% of instruments have positive lagged 20-day returns, and cross-sectional reversal when breadth is weaker. All inputs are lagged before the 10-trading-day forward return evaluation.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample signal is positive; recent 365-day performance is near flat, while recent 180-day and 60-day results are positive. Interpret estimates conservatively given 15-asset cross-section.

provenance.lookahead_control: Signals use completed data through the prior date; forward returns begin at the decision date.
